title: The new menu
new: The menu has a sidebar: Play, Join, Settings, Credits.
It remembers your faction, the bot's faction and the map.
Invite links open Join with the code filled in.

try.text: Start a bot match from Play
Create a friend match and open the link in a second tab
Restart the game and check your last picks are there

questions.text: I found what I wanted in the menu quickly
Not being able to leave the waiting view except with Cancel was fine
The menu filled my window without black bars

title: Every order heard
new: Units answer every order with a short voice line.
The menu has sections; the relay URL sits under Advanced.
Match music is shuffled each match.

try.text: Move infantry, a vehicle and a worker with a right-click
Attack an enemy with a right-click
Send workers to collect supplies
Give orders in an online match
Start a second match and listen to the first track
Online: Copy the join link, open it in a second tab, and paste a code into the join field

questions.text: Every order I gave felt heard
The voices stayed out of the way when I clicked fast
The menu sections made it easy to find things
The match music felt varied between matches

title: FRC economy
new: Playtest helper: ` shows this checklist, N drops a note with a screenshot.
FRC Laborers collect supplies; small piles are separate sources.

try.text: Start an offline match as FRC on any map
Select Laborers and right-click a supply pile
Place a Supply Cache next to a pile
Produce more Laborers at the Supply Cache
Watch your credits for two minutes

questions.text: Right-click collecting did what I expected
Placing the Supply Cache near piles was easy
FRC income felt right for the faction
The checklist and N notes stayed out of the way

title: FRC tunnels, pickups and online
new: Tunnel Hubs and Armed Pickups carry infantry.

try.text: Build a Tunnel Hub
Right-click a Tunnel Hub or pickup with infantry selected
Unload with U
Open the Esc menu and resume
Play FRC online against China or USA

questions.text: Tunnels and pickup riders behaved as I expected

title: The new look in a real match
new: The art lab look is the default now.
M6 fixes: health bars, result text and enemy order marks.

try.text: Zoom in on a fight with the mouse wheel
Attack an enemy building and watch its health bar
Attack-move with A and a left-click
Check whether enemy move orders show on your screen
Finish a match and read the result text

questions.text: Units and buildings were easy to tell apart
Health bars stayed readable during attacks
